sharedPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: contextual illustration next to a Portuguese sentence in an accessible voice-recording research prototype for adults. Style: polished contemporary flat editorial illustration, friendly rounded silhouettes, restrained subtle painted shading, crisp readable edges, mature and welcoming rather than childish, coherent set. Simple centered composition with generous clear space around the complete subject; square image, illustration fills about 75% of frame. Solid warm off-white background #f4f6f2 all the way to edges. Palette: natural warm wood, sage and leaf greens, terracotta coral and sky blue accents. No text, no typography, no labels, no numbers, no UI, no logos, no watermark, no decorative frame. Convey the sentence literally and clearly. Single scene only, no collage.
